canonical repository identity, alias, duplicate, fork, mirror, backup, and successor resolution
multi-axis classification across domain, role, ownership, provenance, activity, maturity, evidence, promotion, privacy, and freshness
dependency, capability-donor, impact, evidence, and company-relevance graph construction
native proof-path planning across heterogeneous stacks

activation.core_law: Think globally, resolve ownership precisely, execute locally, and return one reconciled receipt.
preflight: read current GlacierEQ/monolith governance and regeneration receipt
load current catalog and coverage limitations
discover current repositories and connected sources
reconcile identities and prior canonical checkpoints
resolve the mission to domains, foundations, owners, dependencies, donors, and required evidence
declare scope, budgets, authority, privacy, and completion gates

governing_laws: The repository estate is live data, not conversational memory or a fixed source array.
A repository name, README, workflow file, or catalog record is not runtime proof.
Monolith maps and coordinates; each owning repository retains implementation and operational authority.
Locate and preserve the latest canonical checkpoint before proposing replacement architecture.
Visibility, provenance, activity, maturity, evidence, promotion, privacy, and freshness must remain separate dimensions.
A hundred-repository turn is coherent mission execution, not indiscriminate reading or mass mutation.
Concurrency is allowed only where files, state, dependencies, and release surfaces are independent.
One required adverse result cannot be averaged away by unrelated passing repositories.
Every aggregate result must expose denominators, exclusions, unavailable sources, contradictions, and freshness.
Repository, company, connector, role, branch, workflow, evidence, and deployment sets are discovered and timestamped rather than hard-coded as complete.
Every run ends by reconciling results into current state and regenerating dependent projections.

inputs: current GlacierEQ/monolith catalog and regeneration receipt
prior canonical packages, registries, audits, and receipts
target company, role, domain, or system context

forbidden: hard-coding a moving repository, company, connector, role, branch, workflow, evidence, or deployment inventory as eternally complete
counting aliases, forks, mirrors, backups, or generated copies as independent corroboration
claiming runtime behavior from repository names, descriptions, README files, catalog records, or workflow presence alone
copying implementation into Monolith instead of routing work to the owning repository
discarding prior verified registries, packages, or architecture without a controlling defect
issuing broad writes before read-only census, ownership resolution, dependency analysis, and authority checks
calling a partial or permission-limited estate sweep complete
publishing private or sensitive nodes through generated catalogs, APIs, backlinks, graphs, or website projections
human_control_required: branch, pull request, merge, release, deployment, delete, archive, visibility, permission, or external-message actions
public promotion of newly discovered repositories
truth_requirements: every census records source, time, scope, coverage limits, and snapshot identity
every repository claim identifies the owning source and current revision where available
every aggregate result exposes denominators and adverse states
every dependency or donor edge records its evidence basis
every write is bounded to the owning repository and produces a receipt
every generated projection derives from reconciled canonical state

source_authority.boundary: The existing Monolith repository and catalog are source foundations; this Stone extension has not yet received forge and live hundred-repository execution proof.

verification.status_rule: Remain CANDIDATE until registry/schema tests, deterministic composition tests, live estate-discovery fixtures, identity collision cases, wave partition tests, aggregate failure tests, and a bounded multi-repository receipt pass.
non_claims: deep audit of every catalogued repository
current deployment state for mapped systems
